model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира връзката между степента на разреждане и perplexity за два различни подхода, означени като "Per-Output" и "Per-Layer". Хоризонталната ос показва степените на разреждане, вариращи от 10% до 80% на стъпки от 10%, докато вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Perplexity" и е с логаритмична скала от 10^0 до 10^3. Стойностите на двете категории са представени чрез сини стълби за "Per-Output" и оранжеви стълби за "Per-Layer". При 10% степен на разреждане и двете категории имат стойност малко над 1. С увеличаване на степента на разреждане, perplexity нараства, като при 80% степен на разреждане стойностите са около 600 за "Per-Output" и малко над 800 за "Per-Layer". Стълбите са подредени във възходящ ред според степента на разреждане, като визуално се наблюдава рязко увеличение на perplexity при стойности над 60% степен на разреждане. Няма допълнителни бележки или 강조ряване на конкретни стълби.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar graph illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two categories: Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, labeled with percentages from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with no apparent specific unit. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values from 10^0 to 10^3 in a logarithmic scale; notable tick marks include 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The Per-Output category is depicted by blue bars, while the Per-Layer category is depicted by orange bars. The blue bars have approximate perplexity values of 2, 2, 2, 3, 5, 10, 50, and 400 for sparsity rates of 10% through 80%, respectively. The orange bars have approximate perplexity values of 2, 2, 2, 3, 6, 12, 80, and 500 for sparsity rates of 10% through 80%, respectively. The bars are grouped by sparsity rate, with each category's bar displayed side-by-side for each rate. The bars are ordered by increasing sparsity rate, with no apparent additional visual emphasis or sorting beyond this ordering.
model_annotations.English: This chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two categories, Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, labeled with percentages from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, and is on a linear scale. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values from 10^0 to 10^3 on a logarithmic scale, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The chart features two sets of bars, one for Per-Output in blue and one for Per-Layer in orange, with approximate values as follows: for Per-Output, the bar at 10% sparsity is around 4, increasing to around 950 at 80% sparsity; for Per-Layer, the bar at 10% sparsity is around 4, increasing to around 1,000 at 80% sparsity. The bars are not sorted in a specific order beyond their corresponding sparsity rates, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color representation according to the legend.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Beziehung zwischen dem Dichtegrad und der Perplexity für zwei verschiedene Methoden, die als "Per-Output" und "Per-Layer" bezeichnet werden. Die horizontale Achse stellt den Dichtegrad in Prozent dar, wobei die Beschriftungen in 10%-Schritten von 10% bis 80% reichen. Die vertikale Achse repräsentiert die Perplexity mit einer logarithmischen Skala von $10^1$ bis $10^3$. Die Balken für "Per-Output" sind blau und die für "Per-Layer" orange. Die Balken sind nach Dichtegrad gruppiert, wobei jede Gruppe aus zwei Balken besteht, einer für jede Methode. Die Perplexity-Werte liegen für "Per-Output" zwischen ungefähr 4 und 600 und für "Per-Layer" zwischen 4 und 700. Der niedrigste Wert für beide Methoden liegt bei einem Dichtegrad von 10% und der höchste bei 80%. Die Balken sind in aufsteigender Reihenfolge nach Dichtegrad sortiert.
